shared_elements: standing human/humanoid figures in profile with raised arm
dense field of wedge-shaped script signs arranged in horizontal lines
figural scene combined with an inscription in the same field
low-relief carving with incised interior detail
arrangement into a figural zone and a text zone
stylized emblem/plant motifs above or beside figures
justification: Both surfaces pair a standing profile figure (or figures) shown in low relief with an extensive field of wedge-shaped script arranged in ruled horizontal lines, and in both the figure raises an arm toward a symbolic motif, which is a fairly specific and conventional combination. They differ substantially in the specific iconography: A shows a row of small human worshippers beneath a winged/rayed emblem with text filling most of the panel, while B shows a single large bird-headed winged genie with a handled bucket confronting a stylized flowering tree, with the text confined to a narrow upper band.
